review_candidates.title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
review_candidates.description: Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build. What You'll Do We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development. Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework. Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change. Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it. Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing. Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is. Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide. Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean. Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF. Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation. Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead. What We’re Looking For Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience. 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team. You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against. You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread. You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live. You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate. You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs. You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters. You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time. You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input. Detail and organization come naturally to you. Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business. You play games and care about the industry. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/. Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com. Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice. Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 主要职责: 1、定期观察承包商的运营情况，检查进度和质量是否符合现行进度计划（包括短期计划和合同进度） 2、监控监理公司的报告、检查和补救措施 3、支持高力PjM的商务人员管理变更控制和变更估价 4、与雇主、承包商和监理公司一起监控设备和材料的审批过程，以确保符合ER和进度计划 任务： 1、投标--准备技术文件并参加雇主面试，协调职能部门获得新项目 2、实施--全面负责项目的实施，包括设计、招标、申请政府批准、启动准备、施工、竣工和质保期 3、设计-协助职能部门编写设计概要，审核设计院的设计方案，参加设计审核会 4、招标--进行招标，包括资格预审、编制文件、发放标书、现场勘察、开标、询问答疑、提交评标报告，推荐合格的承包商 5、施工启动--安排和监控承包商或雇主做好临时供水、供电、排水、通讯和道路的准备工作 6、施工--管理和监控雇主、监理和承包商的现场活动，以及项目施工，以实现项目在高质量、按时交付、不超过预算和安全合规方面的目标。管理工程范围的变更和变更估价 7、竣工检查-协调检查和验收活动，发现和记录重要的经验和成就绩，并进行文件归档 8、基于高力PjM的项目管理流程，以高性价比的方式协调和调配公司资源，充分履行高力PjM的服务，赢得雇主的满意 9、起草相关的项目计划和项目报告，参加项目会议，审核并经PM确认后向各相关方发布文件 任职资格: 1、至少3年以上土木，结构工程或建筑和项目管理相关工作以及土木，结构工程或施工管理学位，具有中国HSE要求和中国建筑规范的工作知识 2、熟悉政府审批流程 3、具有中等的英语书面和口语水平 4、了解FIDIC合同条件和项目进度计划的编制 5、具备IT知识和Autocad 2000经验 6、沟通和解决问题的能力 7、了解高力 PjM在项目中的职责 8、商务理解能力 9、必须能够理解并应用雇主要求

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 看看你的工作内容： 1. 设计并实施高级网络安全策略和措施，以保护客户产品的网络免受威胁； 2. 参与网络安全评估项目，评估客户的网络安全状况，并提出改进建议； 3. 评估产品网络安全性能，搭建网络安全评估能力； 4. 与客户沟通，解释网络安全要求，并提供专业建议和解决方案。 我们希望你： 1. 本科及以上学历，网络安全、信息安全、计算机科学、软件工程、电子信息等相关专业优先； 2. 掌握网络安全基础理论和主流安全技术，包括但不限于漏洞分析、渗透测试、安全评估、风险管理及安全加固等，熟悉常见网络安全工具和测试方法，具备漏洞扫描、渗透测试、安全配置检查及安全分析能力； 3. 熟悉网络安全相关标准、法规或行业要求者优先，如 IEC 62443、ISO/SAE 21434、ETSI EN 303 645、NIST Cybersecurity Framework 等； 4. 具备优秀的沟通表达能力和客户服务意识，能够准确理解客户需求并提供专业技术支持； 5. 具备英语读写能力，能够阅读英文技术文档、标准及测试报告。

review_candidates.title: 大模型后训练工程师(Coding Agent)(A94569)
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 我们正在构建面向游戏开发的下一代 AI Coding Agent，探索大语言模型在代码生成、工具调用、环境交互和复杂软件开发任务中的智能化能力。团队聚焦 LLM Post-training、Agentic Reinforcement Learning、Code Agent 和 Agent Evaluation 等前沿方向，希望打造能够自主完成 Unity 游戏开发任务的智能开发助手。 - 负责 Coding Agent 后训练数据体系建设，主导 数据构建、质量评估、数据配比优化和训练数据迭代，持续提升模型在游戏开发任务中的能力。 - 负责模型后训练与合版工作，推动 Base Model → SFT Model → RL Model → Production Model 的完整演进流程，包括模型选择、能力分析、checkpoint 管理、模型 merge 以及效果验证。 - 建立面向 Agent 能力提升的数据闭环，通过分析模型失败案例，定位数据缺陷和能力瓶颈，设计针对性的训练数据和优化策略。 - 面向 Unity 游戏开发场景（Shader、粒子、UI、场景构建、性能分析等），负责领域能力增强方案设计，包括数据策略、训练方法和模型评估。 - 与 Agent 工程团队协作，优化主 Agent + SubAgent 架构中的模型能力分工和协作策略。 职位要求 - 本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、数学等相关专业，硕博优先。 - 具备 大模型后训练团队工作经验，深入参与过 LLM 数据构建和模型训练迭代流程。 - 具备丰富的 训练数据工程经验，包括但不限于： SFT 数据构造、清洗、过滤和质量控制； Preference / RL 数据设计； 多轮 Agent Trajectory 数据生产； 数据混合比例设计和效果分析。 - 具备 模型合版（Model Merge）经验，熟悉： 不同训练阶段 checkpoint 分析； SFT、RL 模型能力对比； 多能力模型融合和效果验证； 模型能力回退和遗忘问题分析。 - 熟悉 LLM 后训练完整流程，包括 SFT、RLHF、DPO、GRPO 等训练方法，并有实际落地经验。 - 具备 Agent、Function Calling、Tool Use 或 Code LLM 相关经验。 - 熟悉分布式训练框架(DeepSpeed、FSDP、Megatron等)，有大规模训练调优经验。 - 具备较强实验分析能力，能够从数据、训练策略和模型结构多个角度定位问题。 加分项 - 有大模型后训练团队实习/工作经历。 - 有Code LLM、Coding Agent的训练经验。 - 有大规模 Agent Trajectory 数据生产和自动化评测经验。 - 有模型能力分析、Benchmark 构建或数据驱动模型优化经验。
